<style>
  body {
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, #f2f6fc, #e3ecf9);
    margin: 0;
    padding: 40px 20px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 100vh;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  #container {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 960px;
    background: #ffffff;
    padding: 30px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
  }

  h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 24px;
    color: #333;
    text-align: center;
  }

  textarea {
    width: 100%;
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 15px;
    border: 1px solid #d3d9e3;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 15px;
    resize: vertical;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background: #f9fbfd;
    color: #333;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  #input {
    height: 200px;
  }

  #output {
    height: 240px;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }

  #buttons {
    display: flex;
    gap: 15px;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .dynamic-button {
    padding: 12px 24px;
    background: linear-gradient(to right, #007bff, #0056d2);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 50px;
    color: white;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.1s ease;
  }

  .dynamic-button:hover {
    background: linear-gradient(to right, #0056d2, #0043a2);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }
</style>

<div id="container">
  <h2>Game JSON to HTML Converter</h2>

  <textarea id="input" placeholder="Paste your game JSON code here..."></textarea>

  <div id="buttons"></div>

  <textarea id="output" readonly placeholder="Converted HTML will appear here..."></textarea>
</div>

<script>
  function convert() {
    const input = document.getElementById('input').value.trim();
    if (!input) {
      alert('Please paste your JSON code first.');
      return;
    }

    let gameData;
    try {
      gameData = JSON.parse(input);
    } catch (e) {
      alert('Invalid JSON. Please check your input.');
      return;
    }

    const htmlCode = generateHTMLFromGameData(gameData);
    document.getElementById('output').value = htmlCode;
  }

  function copyOutput() {
    const output = document.getElementById('output');
    output.select();
    output.setSelectionRange(0, 99999);
    document.execCommand('copy');
    alert('Converted code copied to clipboard!');
  }

  function clearOutput() {
    document.getElementById('output').value = '';
    document.getElementById('input').value = '';
  }

 function generateHTMLFromGameData(gameData) {
  return `
<div id="actual-canvas" style="
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100vw;
  height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: 0;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
"></div>

<script>
  const gameData = ${JSON.stringify(gameData, null, 2)};
  const currentPage = "1";

  function loadScene(pageNum) {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('actual-canvas');
    canvas.innerHTML = '';

    const bg = gameData.pages[pageNum]?.background;
    if (bg) {
      canvas.style.backgroundImage = \`url('\${bg}')\`;
    } else {
      canvas.style.backgroundImage = '';
    }

    const elements = gameData.pages[pageNum]?.elements || [];
    elements.forEach(elData => {
      let el;

      if (elData.tag === 'img') {
        el = document.createElement('img');
        // Handle missing or relative src safely
        if (elData.src && !elData.src.startsWith('http')) {
          el.src = './' + elData.src;
        } else {
          el.src = elData.src;
        }
      } else if (elData.tag === 'button') {
        el = document.createElement('button');
        el.textContent = elData.content || 'Button';
        el.addEventListener('click', () => alert('Button clicked!'));
      } else {
        el = document.createElement(elData.tag);
        el.innerHTML = elData.content || '';
      }

      el.style.cssText = elData.style || '';
      if (elData.top) el.style.top = elData.top;
      if (elData.left) el.style.left = elData.left;
      if (elData.width) el.style.width = elData.width;
      if (elData.height) el.style.height = elData.height;

      if (elData.rotation || elData.scale) {
        const rotation = elData.rotation || '0';
        const scale = elData.scale || '1';
        el.style.transform = \`rotate(\${rotation}deg) scale(\${scale})\`;
      }

      canvas.appendChild(el);
    });
  }

  loadScene(currentPage);
<\/script>`;
}

  // ✅ Moved to the bottom so handlers are defined first
  window.onload = function () {
    const actions = [
      { label: 'Convert', handler: convert },
      { label: 'Copy', handler: copyOutput },
      { label: 'Clear', handler: clearOutput }
    ];
    const buttonsDiv = document.getElementById('buttons');
    actions.forEach(action => {
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.textContent = action.label;
      btn.className = 'dynamic-button';
      btn.onclick = action.handler;
      buttonsDiv.appendChild(btn);
    });
  };
</script>
